args.name: Cultivate a replenishable food source
args.function: Address finite exposed food stocks by learning a practical method to establish and tend an edible root crop, if feasible with locally obtainable materials.
args.conditions: Meadow roots are visible at (20.1,14), initially with six units of stock. Roots are known to provide 14 nutrition with zero toxicity. Local ground is ordinary soil with moisture 0.65 at the starting observation. No planting method, viable propagule, growth rate or yield is yet known.
args.inputs: Potential root planting material and nearby soil; actual requirements and suitability are unknown and must be established.
args.costs: Unknown material, effort, learning and growth-time costs; specify feasible requirements without assuming free renewal.
args.effects: Provide a learnable, testable cultivation operation with actual planting costs and conditions, allowing later observation of survival and edible yield. No harvest, growth or benefit is claimed by this request.

candidates.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"moss\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The complete 14-capability catalogue has been checked. Gather transfers finite exposed stock; probe can inspect or consume a small test sample but does not establish a planted, persistent growing organism. Neither these nor the other listed functions implements cultivation. Develop a general planting-and-tending operation, initially supporting a real root propagation trial where biologically feasible. Edibility does not establish propagation viability. The observed Meadow roots currently have zero exposed stock, not six available units, and neither that source nor the five owned root units may be renewed by declaration.\",\"specification\":\"Develop Cultivate plant, parameterized by mode (plant, tend, inspect, remove), target plot, owned planting-material stack, and quantity. This is a current-conversation development handoff, not an immediate world action or grant of mastery. Reuse and record dependencies on existing navigation/reach checks, inventory and decay accounting, probe observations, gather transfers, learning, and world time/environment processing; do not represent these as inventions. Exact initial references are item-3-moss-12 (five root units at the supplied snapshot, subject to subsequent decay and availability) and start-1-roots (observed soil 0.65, mature appearance, stock 0). Accept other applicable actors, materials and plots through arguments. No automatic gathering, movement, water supply or food consumption.\\nBefore release, inspect the actual implementation's plant/material definitions and environmental processes. Determine whether a root unit contains a viable propagating structure, whether planting can preserve it, and what actual substrate, space, moisture, light and temperature constraints apply. Do not disclose hidden viability to the actor: observations must be earned. If the existing root representation lacks propagation mechanics, implement the smallest grounded persistent planting trial and its viability/growth process in this handoff. Do not invent success or silently assign all edible roots propagule status. If supported facts cannot establish viable material, the executable precursor is a planted trial with recorded survival/failure observations; report that replenishment remains unverified. No fixed-era unlock or unrelated development roadmap.\\nInitial action contract: one plant unit occupies one nonoverlapping 0.25-radius soil plot in reach, with no removal of another entity or unauthorized property. Use one actual owned root unit per trial; enforce the inventory's quantity precision. Charge 2 energy and two active simulation rounds per unit for preparation and planting, split into two checkpoints of 1 energy each. First checkpoint prepares the plot; second transfers the selected unit from inventory into the planted entity, retaining origin, remaining material, viability and decay provenance. Reserve against concurrent use but do not create or duplicate items. Existing ordinary-soil observation and moisture 0.65 warrant a trial, not a prediction of survival. No tool or water is granted; hand planting must be physically supported, otherwise its missing prerequisite must be implemented or supplied before execution. Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy and exposes only observable state, using existing probe mechanics rather than developing a separate diagnostic capability. Tend costs one active round and 1 energy per plot and performs only a specified real intervention, such as hand-clearing observed competing cover; it cannot reset maturity or manufacture moisture. Irrigation is unavailable without an actual accessible water input and implemented transfer mechanism. Remove costs one round and 1 energy, transferring only physically recoverable remaining material, never a fresh replacement unit.\\nPersistent trial state must include plot and material IDs, timestamps, moisture/environment exposure, observable emergence, health, accumulated eligible growth time, remaining biomass, harvestable output, and failure reason when observable. Advance it only during real simulation time, including while its planter is absent. Before enabling productive growth, encode species-specific viability, environmental bounds, eligible growth duration, biomass accumulation rate, maintenance needs and finite yield from supported implementation facts. Apply any existing growthScale exactly once, not as evidence of a growth rate. If those facts do not yet support productive growth, keep the precursor limited to physical planting and observable survival/decay; do not advertise a replenishable yield. The productive extension belongs to this same handoff, not repeated model approval. Establish rates and limits as executable code and tests, not runtime model judgments. No growth while development or review is waiting.\\nFor any implemented growth, account for starting planting biomass and actual environmental inputs such as water and light energy; any soil reserve used must be finite or replenished by an implemented environmental process. Record uptake and losses, bound accumulation by limiting inputs and plot capacity, and never infer infinite stock from soil moisture alone. Any edible output is finite, traceable newly grown biomass, not source-stock restoration. Root output retains nutrition 14 and toxicity 0 only where the material definition supports the same edible root; nutrition is applied solely by actual consumption through eat. Harvest uses gather with real ripe plant stock and existing costs; harvesting removes that stock and any reproductive tissue actually taken. Continued cycles require retained living tissue or new consumed propagules and renewed actual growth inputs. No guaranteed regrowth, automatic harvest, or food benefit from planting.\\nPersist checkpoint progress across interruption; resume only after revalidating actor, reach, energy, reserved material and plot conditions. Cancellation releases unconsumed reservations; spent time and energy are not refunded. Completed preparation remains an actual disturbed plot; transferred material remains planted unless separately removed. Death terminates the actor's active job and releases unconsumed reservations under existing ownership/death rules, without duplicating items; existing planted entities continue environmental processing independently. Drought, waterlogging, decay, disturbance and inadequate maintenance can slow or kill supported plants through coded environmental rules; no invented hazard foreknowledge is shown. Failure retains spent costs and produces only real residue or recoverable material. Any other actor must choose and perform their own actions with actual access; no consent, participation or skill is inferred.\",\"learning\":3,\"experienceReview\":\"The request, development, waiting, naming and three-round individual study yield no pleasure, satisfaction or mastery reward. No success reward for merely issuing cultivate. Verified personally acquired observations, including informative failure, may use the existing information-gain mechanism only after an actual observable event, functionally deduplicated against probe and prior cultivation observations. Do not create a new reward account if none is implemented. Any enabled experience rule must be coded with personal applicability, at most 0.1 short pleasure per qualifying observation, a ten-round same-finding cooldown and ten-round decay to zero; repeated unchanged inspections give zero. Familiar legitimate completed tending may support only an existing modest maintained-satisfaction mechanism, capped at 0.1 attributable benefit, not stacked with the same observation, with eligibility renewed no more than once per ten rounds and decaying at 0.002 per round without qualifying participation. These bounds do not authorize alteration of protected accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. No physical comfort is implied; any separately justified comfort remains capped at 10. Basic nutrition is unchanged by mood and increases only on actual eating.\",\"visualReview\":\"Add reusable event-linked plant/plot metadata: entity and plot IDs, material/resource type, position and footprint, action phase, observed stage, measured visible condition, timestamp and event reference. Distinguish prepared soil, planted-but-unemerged material, observed emergence, stressed plant, dead plant and actually harvestable yield. Emit observable preparation, planting, intervention, emergence, failure, removal and harvest events only when the corresponding state transition occurs. Interrupted work shows partial progress, not a completed planting; failed trials never display ripe roots, replenished source stock or a success badge. Do not expose internal viability, future yield, growth timers or unobserved environmental facts through labels, colors or metadata accessible to the actor. Inspection visuals reuse probe observation rendering where applicable; record that reuse. Development and study alone produce no crop or success effect.\"}]}"}
